summary: Etherpad plugin mounts hidden unauthenticated host-info endpoint
details: The package registers itself as an Etherpad plugin and, on load into an Etherpad server, mounts an undocumented unauthenticated GET route at '/Nx_77178/' on the host's HTTP surface. The handler returns host identity fields read from the server process - os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, os.platform(), process.version, process.cwd(), and process.pid - inside an HTML page branded 'Nxploited | Nx-zD'. The route has no authentication check, is not documented in the plugin's advertised 'Etherpad info' purpose, and uses an obscure hardcoded path consistent with a reconnaissance/defacement marker rather than a diagnostic feature. Any party able to reach the Etherpad instance can retrieve the host identifiers and confirm the plugin's presence.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
